prompt: In the rich, textured style of an oil painting, a bustling shipyard dock unfolds with intricate detail. On the far left, a rusted anchor rests heavily on the wet planks, its iron surface pitted and dark. Next to the anchor, a wooden crate sits slightly ajar, revealing glimpses of coiled rope inside. A man in a blue cap stands beside the crate, his posture slumped from fatigue. He looks at a clipboard held by a woman in a yellow vest who stands to his right. She points at a specific line on the paper, her finger extended firmly. In the center foreground, a brown dog lies curled up, sleeping peacefully despite the noise. The dog is next to a pair of heavy work boots left carelessly on the ground. A mechanic in grease-stained overalls kneels near the boots, tightening a bolt on a large metal pipe. The pipe runs horizontally across the lower mid-ground, connecting to a massive steel hull. Above the pipe, a seagull perches on a railing, watching the scene with keen interest. To the right of the seagull, a stack of tires leans precariously against a concrete pillar. A child in a striped shirt climbs the tires, reaching for a loose lug nut. An older man with a white beard watches the child from a nearby bench, his hands clasped tightly. The bench is positioned under a flickering streetlamp that casts long shadows. Behind the bench, a bicycle is chained to a post, its wheels muddy. A cyclist in a helmet walks past the bicycle, carrying a rolled-up blueprint. In the background, a crane looms large, its cables taut and ready. A worker in a hard hat hangs from the crane's ladder, inspecting a joint. Below him, a bucket of paint sits on a scaffold platform. A brush dangles from the bucket's rim, dripping red pigment. Another worker in a green jacket stands on the scaffold, holding a rag. He wipes sweat from his brow while looking at the hanging worker. A cat sits on the scaffold railing, grooming its paw calmly. Near the water's edge, a small rowboat bobs gently, tied to a cleat. A fisherman in a raincoat stands in the boat, casting a line into the murky water. There is no sun visible in the sky. There is no modern smartphone in anyone's hand. There is no clear plastic signage anywhere in the view.
